resources.string: Close interrupted photo or camera interactions without restoring access.
Open system photo picker or camera
A bounded JPEG or PNG photo is ready. Use this photo to give the app temporary read access.

Photo unavailable, cancelled, expired, too large or unsupported. Only JPEG/PNG up to 8 MiB, 4096 pixels per side and 12 megapixels are accepted. Cameras requiring seekable files or reopening output are unsupported. No thumbnail fallback is used. Streaming photo providers require Android 11 or newer.

Only you can open and approve this system interaction. Jarvys automation remains blocked until native closure or recovery. Selection may use a cloud provider. Original image metadata, potentially including location, is retained. Jarvys does not save to the gallery or automatically send the photo; the external camera may keep its own copy. Access is temporary and cancellation does not recall copies. After interruption, close the external picker/camera yourself before acknowledging recovery; its closure cannot be independently verified.
